content.json:
# Azure Zero Trust Security Posture

Operational workbook for the azure-zerotrust-pipeline Microsoft Sentinel lab. Use it to triage identity movement, privilege changes, Key Vault access pressure, and active Sentinel alerts.

content.query:
datatable(Control:string, RuleFile:string, DataSource:string, DefaultSeverity:string)
[
  'Password-spray followed by successful sign-in', 'sentinel/detection-rules/lateral-movement.kql', 'SigninLogs', 'Medium/High',
  'Privileged role or consent change', 'sentinel/detection-rules/privilege-escalation.kql', 'AuditLogs', 'Medium/High',
  'High-volume Key Vault sensitive object access', 'sentinel/detection-rules/secrets-exfiltration.kql', 'AzureDiagnostics / AzureActivity', 'Medium/High'
]
content.title: Detection coverage

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| summarize Alerts = count() by AlertSeverity
| order by Alerts desc
content.title: Sentinel alerts by severity
Potential lateral movement candidates

content.query:
let PrivilegedRoleOperations = dynamic(['Add member to role', 'Add eligible member to role', 'Add scoped member to role', 'Activate eligible role', 'Add app role assignment to service principal', 'Add delegated permission grant', 'Consent to application', 'Grant admin consent', 'Add owner to application', 'Add owner to service principal']);
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where Category =~ 'RoleManagement' or OperationName has_any (PrivilegedRoleOperations)
| where OperationName has_any (PrivilegedRoleOperations)
| extend InitiatedByUser = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), InitiatedByApp = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName), InitiatedByUserIp = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress), InitiatedByAppIp = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.ipAddress)
| extend AccountName = case(isnotempty(InitiatedByUser), InitiatedByUser, isnotempty(InitiatedByApp), InitiatedByApp, 'Unknown'), IPAddress = case(isnotempty(InitiatedByUserIp), InitiatedByUserIp, isnotempty(InitiatedByAppIp), InitiatedByAppIp, 'Unknown')
| extend TargetResourcesDynamic = todynamic(TargetResources)
| mv-expand TargetResource = TargetResourcesDynamic to typeof(dynamic)
| extend TargetDisplayName = tostring(TargetResource.displayName), ModifiedProperties = todynamic(TargetResource.modifiedProperties)
| extend ModifiedProperties = iff(isnull(ModifiedProperties) or array_length(ModifiedProperties) == 0, dynamic([{}]), ModifiedProperties)
| mv-expand ModifiedProperty = ModifiedProperties to typeof(dynamic)
| extend ModifiedPropertyName = tostring(ModifiedProperty.displayName), ModifiedPropertyNewValue = replace_string(tostring(ModifiedProperty.newValue), '"', '')
| summarize TargetResources = make_set(TargetDisplayName, 20), RoleOrPermissionNames = make_set_if(ModifiedPropertyNewValue, ModifiedPropertyName has_any ('Role.DisplayName', 'RoleDefinition.DisplayName', 'AppRole.DisplayName', 'DelegatedPermissionGrant.Scope')) by TimeGenerated, OperationName, Result = tostring(Result), AccountName, IPAddress, CorrelationId
| extend RoleOrPermissionText = strcat_array(RoleOrPermissionNames, ', ')
| extend Action = strcat(OperationName, '; result=', Result, '; roleOrPermission=', RoleOrPermissionText), Severity = case(tostring(RoleOrPermissionNames) has_any ('Global Administrator', 'Privileged Role Administrator', 'Owner', 'Application Administrator'), 'High', OperationName has_any ('Consent', 'permission grant', 'owner'), 'High', 'Medium')
| project TimeGenerated, AccountName, IPAddress, Action, Severity, OperationName, TargetResources, RoleOrPermissionNames, CorrelationId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Privileged role and consent changes
Key Vault sensitive object access anomalies
